Unique Disciplines:

Magizoologie Courtoise: Diplomatic creature-handling (e.g., calming Chimeras via sonnets).
Geomantic Arithmancy: Predicting magical ley lines through calculus.

Admission Ritual

Flame of Acceptance: Prospective students write names on parchment; blue-flame acceptance burns gold for "exceptional promise."

No Houses: Students sorted into Mentorias — tutelage groups led by seventh-years.

Culture & Traditions

Uniforms: Silk powder-blue robes with moonstone clasps; formal wear includes enchanted lace mantles.

Sport: Pallomagie (aerial ballet-broom hybrid using charmed ribbons). 2nd to Quidditch.

Festival: Balançoire des Fées ("Fae-Swing") — Spring equinox gala where students conjure luminous winged dancers.

Etiquette: Mandatory Cours de Conduite Magique (tea ceremonies with volatile enchanted croissants).

Notable Faculty & Alumni
Name	Role/Achievement
Olympe Maxime	Half-giantess Headmistress (1985–present); master Legilimens.
Fleur Delacour	Triwizard Champion (1994); Curse-Breaker for Gringotts.
Jean-Baptiste Giroux	Alchemy Master; recreated vanishing ink from 14th-century recipes.
Élodie de la Mer	Invented Mare Nostrum Charm (controls tidal waves).
Political Influence

Wand Policy: Favors gemstone cores (aquamarine for charmwork, ruby for combat). Controversially declined to teach wandless magic until 1998.

Grindelwald Era: Secretly harbored refugee students; discreet Resistance cell called Les Étincelles ("The Sparks").

Modern Ties: Hosts ICW summits; primary healers during 2017 French Dragon Pox outbreak.

Controversies & Secrets

Veela Blood Privilege: Veela-descended students (≈25% enrollment) face both reverence and discrimination.

The Scandals:
1789: Headmaster Revère attempted to transfigure Versailles’ Hall of Mirrors into a portal — exiled.
1942: Vichy-collaboration rumors led to ICW tribunal; cleared of charges.

Forbidden Wing: Salle des Cauchemars ("Nightmare Hall") stores cursed artifacts recovered from Lumières Noires cult.

"Beauxbatons is a paradox—a fortress masquerading as a palace. Here, we turn magic into poetry, but never forget: France’s elegance was forged by fire."

— Headmistress Maxime addressing First-Years (1996)

Demographic	Data
Enrollment	820 students (avg.)
Species Diversity	15% part-Veela/human
Wand Woods	Tilia cordata (linden) dominant
Ghosts	Madame Papillionaire (drowned in fountain, 1520)

entries.name: Beauxbatons Academy Curriculum
entries.content:
Academic Divisions & Pedagogical Philosophy
Beauxbatons structures its 7-year program around Les Triomphes ("The Triumvirates"):


Précision Magique (Theoretical & Exact Magic)

Artisanat des Arcanes (Arcane Craftsmanship)

Diplomatie Ésotérique (Magical Diplomacy & Ethics)

Core Tenet: "Finesse supersedes force; magic must marry beauty."

CORE CURRICULUM (Years 1-5)
I. Précision Magique

Charm-Weaving (Tissage de Sortilèges)

Focus: Aesthetic spellcasting (e.g., Color-Changing Charms synced to music).
Text: Perrault's Codex of Chromatic Enchantments
Y4 Specialization: Haute Couture Enchantments (robes reacting to threat-levels).

Alchemy (Grand Art Transmutatif)

Labs: Gold-vaulted chambers with platinum alembics.
Milestones:
Year 2: Brew Larmes de Fée (tear-shaped mood stabilizers).
Year 5: Replicate Flamel’s Argentum Vivum (living mercury defense barrier).

Geomantic Arithmancy (Arithmancie Tellurique)

Unique Skill: Calculate magical ley lines to predict natural disasters.
Fieldwork: Charting Pyrenean energy nexuses.

II. Artisanat des Arcanes

Magizoologie Courtoise

Philosophy: "Creatures are art incarnate."
Practicum:
Soothe Abraxans with Provençal ballads.
Redirect Graphorn charges via pavane steps.

Botanique Enchantée

Greenhouses: Glacier-fed Orangerie Enchantée.
Key Species:
Frostfire Roses (petals burn cold, heal frostbite).
Singer's Ivy (translates wind into symphonies).

Potioncraft (Grande Potionnerie)

Signature Brews:
Parfum de Vérité (truth serum inhaled as scent).
Liqueur des Étoiles Filantes (potion-laced champagne granting levitation).

III. Diplomatique Ésotérique

Magical Law & Ethics (Droit Sorcier)

Text: L'Éthique des Lumières Magiques (cases: Veela rights, Muggle-artifact smuggling).
Mock Trials: ICW tribunal simulations.

Wandlore (Science des Baguettes)

Gemstone Cores: Ruby (combat), Aquamarine (healing), Citrine (transfiguration).
Wood Philosophy: Linden (Tilia cordata) chosen for "resonant flexibility."

ADVANCED ELECTIVES (Years 6-7)
Elective	Description	Professor
Culinary Enchantment	Conjure sentient pastries; cheese sculpting offensive gargoyles.	Patissier Gaston Lenôtre
Astral Projection	Navigate dream-realms via Constellation Canvases.	Séraphine du Lac (Oneiromancer)
Battle Choreography	Dueling as ballet: synchronize hexes to waltz tempo.	Maître Renaud Beauchêne
Memory Palaces	Craft Occlumency shields using architectural mnemonics.	Archiviste Thibault
EXAMS & EVALUATION

Brevet des Arts Magiques (BAM)
Taken Year 5. Practical segments include:
Fitting Room Gauntlet: Enchant 5 robes to counter jinxes in 10 mins.
Alchemy Crossover: Transmute lead into scented soap neutralizing Dark artifacts.

Grand Diplôme de Mage Extraordinaire (GDME)
Year 7 finals. Requires:
Thesis (e.g., "Gemstone Core Resonance in Veela Bloodline Casting").
Performance Exam: Host a 30-min soirée magique while deflecting sabotage spells.

RITES & TRADITIONS

Première Étincelle ("First Spark"): Year 1 ritual – light a floating lantern using one's wand for first time.

Bal des Éléments ("Elements' Ball"): Year 3 masquerade where guests embody fire/water/earth/air via illusions.

Danse de la Flamme Perpétuelle: Graduates add a drop of their magic to the Fountain Sacrée.

NOTABLE CURRICULAR ARTIFACTS

Miroir des Métamorphoses: Practice mirror refining transfiguration poses.

Fontaine à Énoncer: Truth-telling waters for Droit Sorcier debates.

L'Échequier Vivant: Animated chessboard teaching wartime tactics.

CONTROVERSIES & REFORMS

1789–1830: Ban on "revolutionary magic" post-Bastille fall (e.g., Guillotine-Charming).

1942 Curriculum Shift: Dark Arts defense made mandatory after Grindelwald’s Paris raid.

1998 Reforms: Added Contemporary Muggle Technology Interference module post-Statute breaches.


"We do not teach spells; we compose them. Your wand is a baton, and the world awaits your symphony."

— Headmistress Olympe Maxime, Opening Ceremony Address


Academic Calendar Highlights:


October: Festival de la Transfiguration (animate statues compete in fashion shows).

February: Concourse de la Potion Céleste (aerial potion-brewing on brooms).

June: Examen des Jardins (herbology exam in Orangerie’s shifting-maze).

Age 16+: Direct apprenticeship under guildmasters of La Confrérie des Artisans Sorciers.

entries.name: Castelobruxo
entries.content:
Foundation & Cosmic Mandate

Founded: 1100 CE by Shamans of Seven Tribes (Ashaninka, Kayapó, Tupi, et al.) after celestial alignment.

True Name: YVY RUPAPITA (Guarani: "Place Where Earth Watches Sky").

Purpose: Defend Hilo Verde (Green Line) — planetary magical vortex beneath the Amazon.

Castelobruxo Temple-City
Architecture & Defense Systems

Structure: Massive pre-Columbian pyramid complex of living stone covered in predatory vines (Sangrespira vines detonate when touched by dark magic).

Illusions: Fog-shrouded; Muggles see crumbling ruins plagued by jaguars.

Guardians:
Curupira Spirits: Lead intruders in endless circles.
Giant Emerald Tapirs: Teleport threats to Xingu River headwaters.

Water Purification: Rainwater filtered through Lapis Veridus aqueducts cures 90% of poisons.

Academia: Wisdom of the Selva
Core Philosophy: “Magic is a river; wizards merely shape its currents.”

Curriculum Structure: The Three Currents

Corrente da Terra (Earth Current – Herbology/Zoology)

Giant Greenhouse: 40-acre biodome with microclimates.
Key Studies:
Speak Yucatec Maya with Poison Dart Frogs.
Cultivate Walking Palms (relocate on command).

Corrente do Espírito (Spirit Current – Shamanic Magic)

Anima Projection: Merge consciousness with animals (grads become Uiara: dolphin animagi).
Advanced Rituals:
Tupã’s Thunder Summoning: 6th-year storm-conjuring.
Cangaço Wardings (Hex-breaking via folk dance).

Corrente da Água (Water Current – Potions/Healing)

Sacred Waters Lab: Brews drawn from moonlit Amazon tributaries.
Pioneered Potions:
Curare Revitalizer: Paralysis antidote from frog toxins.
Mapinguari Balm: Re-grows bones crushed by giants.

Unique Magical Disciplines
Subject	Description	Exclusive to Castelobruxo?
Panther Transformation	Become Onça Pintada (spiritual jaguars) for jungle travel.	Yes
Tree-Speech	Communicate with sentient Samaúma elders.	Yes
Potamancy	Control river currents to shape landscapes.	Yes
Charm-Carving	Enchant totems to eternally repel dark entities.	Shared with Uagadou
Admission & Rites of Passage

Selection: Tree of Whispers assigns names during wet season floods.

Ordeal (Age 12): Survive 48 hours in jungle using only starter spells:
Rastro Revelio (track magical creatures).
Água Purificadora (water-purifying charm).

Sorting: Colored headdress denotes path: Jaguar (Warriors), Anaconda (Healers), Harpy Eagle (Seers).

Cultural Heartbeat

Festival Macunaíma: Masks crafted from enchanted wood animate to battle evil spirits.

Jogo da Onça: Full-contact soccer played with cursed bouncing stones.

Great Canoe Journey: Final-year trek crafting birdcry-responsive canoes down the Amazon.

Governance & Wars

Leadership: Council of Pajés (7 elder shamans) + elected Guardian of the Tapir Scepter.

Colonial Resistance:
1560: Turned conquistadors into capybaras.
1692: Shielded tribes from Portuguese witch-hunters using fog dragons.

Modern Role: ICW’s prime defender against tropical dark creatures (e.g., escaped Chupacabras, leprosy-spreading Lobisomens).

Secrets & Scandals

The Forgotton Floor: Submerged level containing Vaticano Soterrâneo (Inquisition prisons for captured European dark wizards).

1925 Scandal: Headmaster kidnapped to brew immortality elixir for rubber barons → rescued by rebellious curinga monkeys.

Dangerous Alumni: Beto Baca-Bacana (No-Maj drug lord) secretly cloned Carnivorous Snails for cartels.

Demographics & Statistics
Category	Data
Species Diversity	45% human, 30% caboclo-spirit hybrids, 25% river-beings
Wand Cores	Arapaima Scales (water affinity), Jaguar Whisker (combat)
Ghosts	Maria da Taoca (Cuca crone who tests student courage)

“Castelobruxo doesn’t tame the jungle—it teaches you to bow to it. Here, the trees grade your spells.”

— Pajé Aritana, addressing ICW (1999)


Notable Alumni	Legacy
João Coiote	Invented Sun Shield Charm blocking UV magic.
Luzia Silvestre	Negotiated peace between Acromantulas and Yanomami tribes.
Thiago Verde-Rio	Weaned the Dragon-Serpent of Xingu off human flesh.
Legacy Challenges

Deforestation Crisis: Students tasked with reforesting via Instant-Growth Charms.

New Threats:
Poacher use of Anti-Apparition Tech.
Corrupted Curupira: Spirit-policeman bribed with firewhisky.

2020 Initiative: "Green Dragon Census" to protect native dragons.

The Blackwater Oath:

Graduates drink piranha-infused potion, swearing:


“My blood for the Amazon’s breath, my magic for its heartbeat.”

entries.name: Castelobruxo Syllabus
entries.content:
Pedagogical Foundation: The Five Roots
"A wizard who cannot speak to rivers or reason with jaguars is no wizard at all."

Castelobruxo's curriculum builds upon ancestral tribal epistemologies:


Mágica Não Domina, Convive ("Magic Coexists, Does Not Dominate")

Floresta é Mestre ("The Forest is the Teacher")

Sangue-Terra Sagramento ("Blood-Earth Covenant")

CORE CURRICULUM
(Years 1-5: Mandatory Disciplines)

I. EARTH CURRENT (Corrente da Terra)

Advanced Herbology (Matéria Verde)

Labs: Bio-luminescent greenhouses mimicking 12 micro-biomes.
Key Units:
Samaúma Diplomacy: Negotiate with sentient giant kapoks.
Carnivorous Garden Tending: Harvest Pitaya Doce without losing fingers.
Healing Vines: Sipó Amarração binds wounds via song.

Tribal Magizoology (Bichos-Falantes)

Methods: Hypnotic chants to pacify aggressors.
Mastery Tiers:
Year	Creature Tier	Rite
2	Curupira	Foot-backwards tracking test
5	Mapinguari	Survive bone-crushing "hug"

II. SPIRIT CURRENT (Corrente do Espírito)

Kaxinawá Soulcraft (Viagem da Alma)

Psychonautics: Brew Ayahuasca Mariri for spirit journeys (supervised).
Defensive Rituals:
Anhangá Ward – Repel malevolent spirits using tapir-bone totems.
Cobra-Grande Trance – Enter serpent mind to detect poachers.

Tree-Speech & Stone-Song (Língua das Raízes)

Lexicon: Learn Tupi-Guarani dialects for geomancy.
Practical: Redirect rivers via quartz monolith harmonics.

III. WATER CURRENT (Corrente da Água)

Potioncraft of the Flooded Forest (Poções do Igapó)

Sacred Sources: Moon-blessed water from Rio Negro tributaries.
Signature Brews:
Piracema Revival Tonic – Restores magical exhaustion with piranha scales.
Yara Love Draught – Mist that charms river dolphins into guides.

Tropical Hex Defense (Escudo Verde)

Jungle Tactics:
Turn curses into harmless vines (Maldição Enraizada).
Summon leaf-cutter ant swarms to dismantle dark constructs.

YEARLY MILESTONES
Year	Rite of Passage	Danger Level
1	Spend night alone in Templo das Sombras (shadow-jaguar trial)	★★★☆☆
3	Harvest venom from Ariranha Mágica without sedation	★★★★☆
5	Pacify a lost Mula Sem Cabeça using only folk songs	★★★★★
7	Jornada Final: 40-day solo jungle trek to brew Elixir of the Emerald Canopy	★★★★★★
ADVANCED ELECTIVES (Years 6-7)

Anaconda Animagi

Morph into aquatic serpents; navigate underground rivers.
Risk: Permanent scale-growth if focus falters.

Amazonian Astromancy (Estrelas da Ursa Maior Sob a Linha do Equador)

Navigate via distorted constellations; predict rainy seasons.

Morphogenic Warfare (Guerra Morfógena)

Biologically engineer plants into siege weapons:
War Yuca – Projects spines like shrapnel.
Strangler Fig Tactics – Trap enemies in wooden cages.

Pirarucu Economics

Magically farm giant fish to fund school operations.

EVALUATION: TRIALS OF THE GREEN GODS

Oral Exams: Defend thesis before tribal elders and tree-spirits.

BAMAS (Brazilian Amazonian Magical Accreditation Standards):
Phase 1: Translate ancient petroglyphs while repelling mosquito-swarm jinxes.
Phase 2: Brew storm-summoning potion using monsoon rain.

Final Grade: Carved into student's ritual staff by Samaúma Elder.

CONTROVERSIAL INCLUSIONS

Forbidden Unit: Visagem Necropsia (autopsy of benign forest ghosts to harvest Luz Fantasma – banned by ICW in 1988).

Guerreiro da Borracha Syllabus: Students learn to sap magical trees for emergency potions – criticized as "dark botany."

ACADEMIC TRADITIONS

Chuva dos Encantos ("Rain of Spells"): First-years drenched in potion-storm granting bilingual fluency.

Dança da Harpia: Graduates perform aerial ritual to summon harpy eagles as familiars.

Festa do Boto: Shape-shift into river dolphins for underwater celebrations.


"Castelobruxo does not graduate wizards—it awakens curandeiros, pajés, and guardiões who remember the jungle's true name."

— Pajé Yara, Spirit-Walker of the Xingu


Legacy Artifacts in Teaching:


Pedra do Sol Encantada: Solar-powered crystal mapping 200+ miles of magical ley lines.

Mapa das Águas Assombradas: Piranha-skin scroll revealing drowned spirit colonies.

Curriculum Shifts Post-2010:


Added Tech-Shielding against satellite surveillance.

Replaced Curare Extraction with synthetic alternatives after ICW pressure.

entries.name: Durmstrang
entries.content:
Foundation & Ideological Spine

Founded: 1294 by Nerida Vulchanova, a Bulgarian dark arts adept dissatisfied with "soft" European magic.

Usurpation: Harfang Munter murdered Vulchanova (1317), establishing permanent martial rule.

Motto: "Sanguine et Ferro" ("By Blood and Iron").

Core Philosophy: "Magic is a weapon; sentiment is armor's crack."

Affiliation: Historical alliance with Tsarist Russian wizards (1700s) and Grindelwald's Reich (1940s).

Durmstrang Fortress
Arctic Stronghold & Defenses

Location: Norwegian Sea glacier range (coordinates erased via Tabula Rasa charm).

Structure: Vulchanova Bastion – carved into glacial rock; reinforced with enslaved Mountain Troll labor (1298-1312).

Wards:
Fimbulwinter Shield: Eternal blizzard obscuring approach.
Bloodline Locks: Doors open only to verified wizarding lineages.
Sentinel Golems: Ice giants patrolling the perimeter.

Notable Feature: The Black Galleon – enchanted ship melts ice for sea travel; reveals dragon-head prow when threatened.

Academic Doctrine: The Three Axes of Power
(No elective choices – specialized tracks assigned Year 3 based on dueling trials)

AXIS I: MARITAL SORCERY

Combat Transfiguration (Animagi de Bellum)

Focus: Weaponized morphing – conjure barbed shields; turn cloaks into iron maiden cages.
Elite Tier: Fenrir Animagi – werewolf-resistant battle forms (requires lycanthrope blood affinity test).

Dark Arts Praxis (Nocturna Ars)

Curriculum Evolution:
Year 1-2: Theory of unforgivables + blood replenishment via leeches.
Year 5-7: Cast Imperius on fellow students (under supervision for "resistance training").
Forbidden Texts: Munter's Grimoire (banned by ICW since 1899) taught in cipher.

AXIS II: ANCESTRAL ARCANUM

Necrotic Runes (Mortuus Vult)

Blood Inscription: Carve Elder Futhark into skin for power boosts – Ansuz (endurance) / Thurisaz (pain projection).
Rite: Scarification Ordeal at Year 4 – failure rate: 29%.

Lineage Magic (Sanguis Majorum)

Rituals: Summon ancestor spirits (dragonfire-lit séances) to enhance spell potency.
Taboo: Muggle-born students cannot access (source of historical exclusion).

AXIS III: STRATEGIC DOMINION

Arctic Warfare (Glacies Martis)

Field Training: Control ice floes as battle platforms; survive prolonged exposure without warming charms (Siberian survival techniques).
Creature Handling: Subjugate Snow Serpents using pain-compliance runes.

Political Hexcraft (Ordo Ex Chao)

Deception Protocols: Brew Potio Discordiae to inflame rivalries + practice treasonous persuasions.
Case Studies: Grindelwald's coup attempts (role-playing as ICW delegates).

Annual Trials (Fail = Expulsion or Death)
Year	Trial	Objective
1	Rite of the Frozen Heart	Spend 24hrs naked on glacier (30% hypothermia).
4	Gauntlet of Munter	Disable 12 cursed statues in dueling hall.
7	Blóðregn ("Blood Rain")	Survive avalanche while disarming opponents.
Cultural Pillars

Uniform: Blood-red wool cloaks with black bear fur linings; steel gorget (throat armor).

Symbol: Double-headed eagle gripping wand/sword over Grindelwald's Skull Sigil (secretly used in initiations).

Traditions:
Midvinter Blót: Sacrifice magical beasts to ancestral spirits; drink chalice of charmed blood.
Krum's Legacy: Viktor Krum's dragon-horn trophy enshrined after 1994 Triwizard victory.

Sport: Glacier Quidditch – played on ice floes; Bludgers replaced by chained Doxy swarms.

Governance & Executions

Leadership: Headmaster = Warlord (absolute authority); Council of Iron Wands (ex-generals) vetoes policies.

Punishments:
Minor: Whipping hexes (scar permanently).
Major: Thrown into Munter's Maw glacial crevasse.

Key Rulers:
Harfang Munter (1317-1360): Executed 183 students for "cowardice."
Igor Karkaroff (1985-1996): Fled after Voldemort’s return.
Current: General Gorstag (eagle animagus; purged Grindelwald loyalists).

Secrets & Scandals

The Purge of '48: Disposal of Muggle-born corpses via cursed fjord tidal bore ("Maelstrom Classified").

Lost Expedition: 7 students attempted to breach Šlėktā Mintis (Thought Prison) in 1555 – only claws returned.

Forbidden Wing: Obsidian Ziggurat extending miles underground; houses captured Njord elemental spirits.

Demographics	Data
Enrollment	~320 students (71% purebloods)
Regions	Scandinavia, Russia, Balkans
Wands	Reinforced Ash + Salamander Ash Core (combat reliability).
Ghosts	Nerida Vulchanova – wails nightly at exact murder coordinates.
Notable Alumni
Name	Legacy
Gellert Grindelwald	Attended 1898-1900; expelled for "bloodmill experiments."
Viktor Krum	Triwizard Champion; refused Dark Mark.
Irina Volkova	Pioneer of Cryomancy Sutures (freezes wounds in combat).
Legacy War & Reformation

Grindelwald's Shadow: Secret Final Rite chambers show maps of Nurmengard.

Post-1998 Reforms: ICW enforces "Unforgivable Watch" observers after Karkaroff’s alliances.

Modern Doctrine: Officially disavows blood purity; six Muggle-born students enrolled (2020-2024).


"Durmstrang sharpens souls into blades. Remember: even the sharpest steel snaps when swung without purpose."

— General Gorstag's address to first-years

entries.name: Durmstrang Syllabus
entries.content:
Pedagogical Doctrine: The Iron Codex Principles

Magic As Weaponry: Spells judged solely by efficacy, not ethics.

Ancestral Supremacy: Lineage determines magical capacity; purebloods prioritized.

Survival of the Strongest: 15% attrition rate deemed "acceptable."

CORE CURRICULUM (Years 1-5)
No elective choices – Specializations assigned Year 3 via Trial by Glacial Combat

I. COMBAT DISCIPLINES

Martial Transfiguration (Mutatio Bellorum)

Y1-2: Turn daggers into serpent swarms; conjure iron-spike barricades.
Y5: Forge Fenrir Armor – skin-transfiguration resisting werewolf bites.
Text: Munter's Grimoire: Shrapnel Morphing Techniques (Ch. 12: "Flaying Charm Offensives").

Dark Arts Praxis (Ars Nocturna)

Escalating Curriculum:
Year	Content	Risk Level
1	Sectumsempra theory + Blood-Replenishing Leeches	★★☆
3	Inferi Resistance Drills	★★★★
5	Imperius Crucible: Control classmates in obstacle courses	★★★★★

Arctic Warfare (Glacies Martis)

Survival Skills:
Melt ice for drinking water via Flamma Sanguinis (blood-ignition charm).
Detect yeti ambushes using Rune of Hreth carved into palm.
Creature Combat: Subjugate Ice Yeti with pain-compliance curses.

II. ANCESTRAL & RITUALISTIC ARTS

Necrotic Runes (Runae Mortuae)

Blood Inscription: Students carve Elder Futhark into their skin:
Eihwaz (Endurance) on ribs.
Thurisaz (Pain-Projection) on knuckles.
Y4 Ordeal: Scarification Ritual – failure = sepsis or blood loss (29% morbidity).

Lineage Evocation (Sanguis Majorum)

Séances: Summon warrior-ancestors for combat wisdom; dragonfire-lit Blót Circles.
Restriction: Muggle-born students assigned menial tasks during rituals.

III. STRATEGIC & POLITICAL ARTS

War Alchemy (Alchimia Ferrea)

Signature Brews:
Potio Discordiae: Induces paranoia in enemy ranks via vapor.
Gore-Fire Gel: Explodes on contact with dark creature flesh.
Lab: Melted-glacier cavern with enchanted tungsten cauldrons.

Subterfuge & Treasoncraft (Operatio Umbra)

Grindelwald Case Studies: Infiltration tactics used in 1940s ICW coup attempts.
Assassination Magic: Silent-killing techniques (e.g., Orb of Suffocation).

SPECIALIZED TRACKS (Years 6-7)
Assigned by Year 3 Trial performance

Track	Curriculum Focus	Instructor
Dreadnought Division	Siege magic; golem animation	General Gorstag
Shadow Weavers	Assassination/espionage magic	Prokopy Petrov (ex-Obliviator)
Blood Marshals	Lineage magic amplifications	Vorlag Bloodstone
Ice Callers	Macro-cryomancy (avalanche summoning)	Fjolla Nansen
ANNUAL ORDEALS
Year	Trial	Objective	Failure Consequence
1	Rite of Frozen Heart	24hrs naked on Sprengelbreen Glacier	Hypothermia/Expulsion
3	Gauntlet of Munter	Disarm cursed statues in moving labyrinth	Petrification (temp.)
5	Fimbulwinter Siege	Fortify outpost against blizzard yetis	Severe frostbite
7	Blóðregn ("Blood Rain")	Last-student-standing duel during avalanche	Death
CULTURAL RITES & RITUALS

Midvinter Blót: Sacrifice magical beasts (e.g., Granian winged horses) to ancestral spirits; drink from chalice of charmed blood.

Krum's Day: Celebrate Viktor Krum’s Triwizard feats with live Doxy Quidditch.

Graduation: Carve lineage rune onto Obsidian Obelisk; oath-sworn to defend Durmstrang secrets.

CURRICULUM ARTIFACTS

Iron Sentinel Golems: Sparring partners in combat transfiguration (react to pain curses).

Munter's Maw: Bottomless glacial crevasse used for disposing of failed potions/dissidents.

Šlėktā Mintis Prison: Training ground resisting psychic attacks from trapped dark entities.

CONTROVERSIAL UNITS (ICW-Monitored)

Forbidden Hexcraft: Practical lessons casting Bone Shattering Curse (Osseus Confringo).

Bloodline Thaumaturgy: Boosting spell power via ritualistic scarring (banned practice, secretly taught).

Valkyrie Channeling: Summon spectral warriors – 7 students trapped in Valhalla limbo since 1890.

POST-WAR REFORMS (POST-1998)

"Karkaroff Amendments":
ICW observers audit Dark Arts classes.
Imperius Training now uses mannequins, not students.

Muggle-Born Admissions: 6 enrolled since 2020; assigned bodyguards due to harassment.


"A Durmstrang education strips magic to its bones. What remains is what wins wars."

— General Gorstag, Iron Treatise on Magical Superiority


Known Text Excerpts:

markdown

⚔️ *Combat Transfiguration Final Exam (Y5):*  
"Transfigure opponent's wand into venomous serpent within 8 seconds while maintaining glacial foothold."  

🩸 *Blood Magic Thesis Requirement (Y7):*  
"Demonstrate how ancestral summoning doubles Cruciatus efficacy against giants."  
Faculty & Method Notes:


Current Head: General Edvard Gorstag (eagle animagus; purged 14 Grindelwald loyalists in 1999 coup).

Viktor Krum's Influence: Added Dragon-Horn Sculpting (carving wards into dragon horn fragments).

2023 Innovation: Draugr Sentry Programming – corpse guardians patrolling vaults.

For restricted syllabi (e.g., Ars Nocturna Y7) apply via Warlord's Chancery with blood sample.

entries.name: Hogwarts
entries.content:
Founding & Sacred Duty

Established: c. 993 CE by Godric Gryffindor, Helga Hufflepuff, Rowena Ravenclaw, and Salazar Slytherin.

Purpose: Provide sanctuary and education during Muggle witch hunts; protect British magical bloodlines.

Motto: "Draco Dormiens Nunquam Titillandus" ("Never Tickle a Sleeping Dragon").

Magical Nexus: Built atop ley line convergence (amplifies magic; causes temporal anomalies).

The Castle Anatomy
Architecture & Secrets

Location: Scottish Highlands (Unplottable; Muggles see ruins with "Keep Out" signs).

Structure:
7 main towers (Astronomy Tower tallest); 142 staircases; 3,000+ rooms.
Stone walls enchanted to repair themselves; portraits spy for Headmaster.

Key Rooms:
Location	Purpose
Chamber of Secrets	Basilisk lair under Moaning Myrtle's bathroom.
Room of Requirement	Transforms to user's needs (Vincent Crabbe's Fiendfyre destroyed it, 1998).
Wand-Lighting Chasm	Training pit where first-years learn Lumos.
Forbidden Corridors
Third Floor East Wing: Former Cerberus guarding trapdoor (1991).
West Septum: Leads to Elf Slavery Tunnels (freed in 1998).

Defensive Systems

Wards:
Anti-Apparition (except House-Elves/Headmaster).
Muggle-Repelling Charms.
Protego Maxima/Fianto Duri/Repello Inimicum trio cast annually.

Guardians:
Hogwarts Sentience: Awakens during existential threats (e.g., sealed corridors during Battle of Hogwarts).
Statue Army: Activated by Piertotum Locomotor (Minerva McGonagall, 1998).

Academic Framework
The House System
House	Founder	Traits	Ghost	Common Room
Gryffindor	Godric Gryffindor	Courage/Chivalry	Nearly Headless Nick	Gryffindor Tower (7th floor)
Hufflepuff	Helga Hufflepuff	Loyalty/Fair-Play	Fat Friar	Kitchen-adjacent (basement)
Ravenclaw	Rowena Ravenclaw	Intellect/Creativity	Grey Lady	Ravenclaw Tower (west wing)
Slytherin	Salazar Slytherin	Ambition/Cunning	Bloody Baron	Dungeons (under Black Lake)
Sorting: Sorting Hat (Gryffindor’s enchanted relic) performs legilimency to assign houses.

Core Curriculum (Years 1-5)

Transfiguration: Theory/practice of molecular alteration (McGonagall).

Potions: Brewing under Sirius Black’s grandfather’s portraits (Snape/Slughorn).

Charms: Precision spellwork (Flitwick).

Defence Against the Dark Arts: Cursed position (Quirrell to Carrow).

Herbology: Poisonous/combative flora (Sprout).

Astronomy: Charting celestial magical currents (Sinistra).

History of Magic: Taught by ghost Professor Binns (since 1700s).

Electives (Year 3+)

Arithmancy: Predictive numerology (Vector).

Divination: Genuine seers rare (Trelawney).

Care of Magical Creatures: Dragonology/Thestral taming (Hagrid).

Muggle Studies: Post-1998 changed to Muggle-Wizard Relations (Granger et al.).

Ancient Runes: Translating enchantments (Babbling).

Exams

O.W.L.s (Ordinary Wizarding Levels): Taken Year 5; dictate career paths.

N.E.W.T.s (Nastily Exhausting Wizarding Tests): Taken Year 7; university/ministry jobs.

Cultural Heartbeat

Sport:
Quidditch: House Cup tournaments (seeker catches Golden Snitch = 150 pts).
Triwizard Tournament: Revived 1994; tragically fatal reboot.

Traditions:
Sorting Feast: Enchanted ceiling mimics sky (Great Hall).
House Elves: Cook feasts; freed by Hermione’s S.P.E.W. campaign.
Hogsmeade Weekends: Year 3+ visit wizarding village.

Ghosts: Peeves the Poltergeist (chaos entity bound to castle).

Governance & Politics

Leadership: Headmaster (Dumbledore, Snape, McGonagall) + Board of Governors (12 members).

Sacred Texts:
Hogwarts: A History (Hermione Granger’s "bible").
Secret Histories by Bathilda Bagshot (includes Slytherin’s rift).

Resilience Against Regimes:
1995-96: Ministry interference via Dolores Umbridge.
1997-98: Death Eater control under Snape.

Notable Faculty & Residents
Name	Role	Legacy
Albus Dumbledore	Headmaster (1971-1997)	Defeated Grindelwald; Order founder
Rubeus Hagrid	Keeper of Keys/Grounds	Secretly Aragog’s breeder
Argus Filch	Squib caretaker	Dreams of medieval punishments
Firenze	Divination Professor (post-Trelawney)	Centaur pardoned for aiding humans
Timeline of Pivotal Events

c. 1000: Slytherin builds Chamber of Secrets; grafts Basilisk egg into plumbing.

1492: Peeves manifests from student chaos; becomes permanent pest.

1943: Tom Riddle opens Chamber; frames Hagrid.

1991: Philosopher’s Stone protected; Quirrell’s downfall.

1993: Basilisk attacks; Ginny Weasley possessed.

1994: Sirius Black infiltrates; Pettigrew escapes.

1995: Voldemort resurrected; Dumbledore re-founds Order.

1998: Battle of Hogwarts – 50+ casualties; Voldemort defeated.

Secrets & Mysteries

Founders' Relics:
Gryffindor’s Sword (goblin-made; imbued with Basilisk venom).
Ravenclaw’s Diadem (lost → destroyed by Fiendfyre).
Slytherin’s Locket (Horcrux).
Hufflepuff’s Cup (Horcrux).

The Hidden Vault: Chamber guarded by Pearl-Scaled Dragon (nesting since 1603).

Lake Entities:
Merpeople Colony: Hosts Second Task (1995).
Giant Squid: Saves first-years (1942).

Demographics & Legacy
Aspect	Data
Enrollment	~600 students (ages 11-17)
Elf Population	102 (pre-1998); now voluntary contract
Notable Alumni	Merlin, Newt Scamander, Tom Riddle
Ghost Population	20+ (excl. Peeves)

"Hogwarts will always stand guard against the dark. Its stones remember every sacrifice—and sing with magic yet unbroken."

— Minerva McGonagall, post-battle address, May 1998


Appendices
A.N.

Hogwarts Express (Red Engine #5972) has run since 1830; boarded at Platform 9¾.

Spew Regulations: Post-Elf freedom, kitchens remain open via paid employment.

Post-War Curriculum: Added Dark Arts Rehabilitation Studies (2010).

Castle's Secret
Built with Anti-Death Spell Matrix—Voldemort could not cast Avada Kedavra indoors in 1998.

For expanded entries:


Hogwarts: The Map Collection (Marauders’ enchanted parchment mechanics)

Herbology Atlas of Greenhouse Three (devil’s snare breeding program)

The Founders' Letters (Rowena’s coded prophecies)

entries.name: Hogwarts Curriculum
entries.content:
Foundational Doctrine: The Four Pillars
Hogwarts' magic grows from its founders' philosophies woven into castle stones:


Gryffindor's Gambit: "Courage tempers power—a spell cast in fear unravels at its core."

Ravenclaw's Resonance: "Magic is an equation begging to be rewritten."

Hufflepuff's Covenant: "All magic springs from the earth's pulse; humility is the key."

Slytherin's Edict: "Ambition without control is poison; control without ambition is waste."

YEAR 1-5 CORE CURRICULUM
I. TRANSMUTATIVE ARTS

Foundational Transfiguration (Minerva McGonagall)

Castle Synergy: Lessons near North Tower amplify precision (Rowena's Arithmancy wards).
Lore Integration:
Match-to-Needle channels Hufflepuff's earth alignment.
Avifors (bird transfiguration) requires conjuring Ravenclaw’s signature feather quill form.
Text: Intermediate Transfiguration includes Gryffindor’s marginalia on "combat morphing."

Charms (Filius Flitwick)

Environmental Casting: Moving staircases force stabilization charms.
Magical Theory:
Vocalizing spells in the Serpentine Corridor (Slytherin’s domain) boosts potency
Wingardium Leviosa failures manifest stair poltergeists.
Peculiarity: Ghosts "edit" spell outcomes (Nearly Headless Nick slurs Lumos Maxima).

II. EARTH & POTIONS LORE

Herbology (Pomona Sprout)

Greenhouse Mystique:
Greenhouse 3’s soil mixed with Helga’s Cup replica guarantees fertility.
Devil’s Snare retreats only when sung Hufflepuff hymns.
Lethal Flora: Venomous Tentacula milked for Slytherin dungeon antidotes.

Potions (Severus Snape/Horace Slughorn)

Dungeon Alchemy:
Lake Vapors: Black Lake mist alters ingredient potency (e.g., makes fluxweed nocturnal).
Cauldrons charred by accidental Gryffindor Fire-Breathing Hexes retain combat properties.
Founder Recipes:
Slytherin’s Ossis Regenerum (bone-regrowth draft, requires adder venom).
Hufflepuff’s Seadream Draught (harvested from Giant Squid ink).

III. DEFENSIVE & HISTORIC ARTS

Defense Against the Dark Arts (Cursed Position)

Classroom Shifts: Location changes annually to evade curse (RoR connection in 1997).
Practical Units:
Dementor-drills in Azkaban Simulation Chamber (secret sub-basement).
Patronus Charms taught near Gryffindor Tower (amplifies happy memories).

History of Magic (Professor Binns)

Ghost-Led Ritual: Students touch Founders’ Relics to witness historical events (e.g., touch the Sorting Hat for 993 CE memory).
Famed Lectures:
Giant Wars taught beside *Filius’ lance scar (sealed in trophy room).
Salazar’s Betrayal retold in Chamber entrance antechamber.

YEAR 3+ ELECTIVES
Subject	Secret Mechanics	Location Spell-Lock
Arihmancy	Calculus alters Prophecy Record crystals	Tower of Libations (raven gargoyles)
Divination	True prophecies fog Sybill’s Inner Eye	Dumbledore's cricket-free tower
Care of Magical Creatures	Thestrals guide to Death Day Party crypts	Forbidden Forest Omega Gate
Ancient Runes	Wardrune carving unlocks Obol Vaults	Ravenclaw’s diadem mural
Muggle Studies	Practicums disguised as Hogsmeade stakeouts	Room of Requirement-hidden Muggle street
O.W.L.S & N.E.W.T.S: Trials by Blood and Lore

O.W.L. Practical Enhancements:
Transfiguration examiners test conjuration in Moving Staircase Gauntlet.
Potions brewed using Black Lake water (tests impurity adaptation).

N.E.W.T. Rituals:
Aetherius Proving: Stand atop Astronomy Tower during thunderstorm casting shield charms.
Fidelius Gauntlet: Hide an object within Hogwarts that not even professors find (Fred & George's legacy test).

FOUNDER-SPECIFIC MAGIC
Restricted to students excelling in house attributes


Gryffindor: Sword-Summoning Charm (pulls Godric's replica from artifacts).

Slytherin: Lacertus Maledictus (serpent hypnosis via Parseltongue subvocalizations).

Ravenclaw: Mnemosyne Manuscripts (download books via diadem contact).

Hufflepuff: Geodormius Revival (repair damaged stone with touch).

CURRICULUM ARTIFACTS
Relic	Pedagogical Role	Origin
Sorting Hat	Verbalizes founder ghosts during exam crises	Gryffindor
Whomping Willow	Self-defense final (avoid/transfigure roots)	1700s curse
Mirror of Erised	Psychology of desire unit (DA lessons)	Ravenclaw
Polyjuice Crucible	Sixth-year potions trial (disguise as teacher)	Snape's stash
POST-WAR REFORMS

Hermione Granger’s Amendments:
Elf magic added (Kreacher’s Kitchen Diplomacy module).
Muggle technology wards practicum (silence cellphones) replaces Blood Quills ban.

Slytherin Reformation:
Healing Arts track alternative to Dark Manipulation.
Field trips to Azkaban for "de-radicalization studies."

FORBIDDEN SYLLABI
Excised from text but whispered in the Come and Go Room:


Year 7 Only:
Basilisk Husk Armor Crafting (Chamber bones).
Fiendfyre Barrier Techniques (taught by death eaters in exile).

Legacy Spells:
Slytherin’s Perenmortis Lock seals Dark objects
Gryffindor's Blade of Moraltas counters Unforgivables


"Hogwarts teaches what Britain is. Not stones and spells, but ruthless courage, cunning earth-wisdom, furious thought... and the seeds of rebirth."

— Headmistress McGonagall addressing ICW, 2005


Grade Impact Factors:

Location	Effect
Great Hall	Spells gain flair (confetti sparks)
Forbidden Forest	Spell duration +40%
Girls' Bathroom	Boils water-based magics
Headmaster's Tower	Truth detection enhanced
Archival Gloss


The Map Chamber secretly records student movements for adaptive lesson plans.

First-years chanting Lumos inadvertently recharge castle wards with magical runoff.

Blood Quill Tribunal Room: Snape's writings reveal cursed syllabus items

entries.name: Ilvermorny
entries.content:
Foundation: A Wanderer's Sanctuary (1620-1630)

Founders:
Isolt Sayre (Irish orphan, descendant of Salazar Slytherin).
James Steward (No-Maj builder, first "Groundskeeper").
Adopted Sons: Chadwick & Webster Boot (rescued survivors of Dorcus Twelvetrees' attack).

Origins: Began as a stone cottage atop Mount Greylock, Massachusetts. Built using:
Wampanoag Masonry Techniques (aligned with starlight).
Salazar Slytherin's Stolen Wand (rowan wood, horned serpent core).

Sacred Stone: Gideon Gray's Foundation Stone – absorbs residual magic to protect against dark forces.

Architecture & Magic Ecology

Structure: Gothic castle with Wampanoag woodcarvings; modern expansions include Naumkeag tribal wigwam annexes.

Key Locations:
The Gordian Knot Atrium: Moving staircases braided like woven baskets.
Twin Star Libraries: Separate sections for Wizarding & Indigenous magical texts.
The Unfinished Tower: Grows when unresolved student conflicts fester.

Guardians:
Pukwudgie Patrol (led by William, Isolt's ally).
Thunderbird Sentries: Weather-control avians nesting on parapets.

House System: The Four Totems
Bonded to founding spirits via The Vow of the Stone Heart

House	Founder	Attributes	Totem	Dormitory
Horned Serpent	Isolt Sayre	Wisdom/Scholarship	Crystal-scaled river spirit	North Tower (stellar observatory)
Wampus	Webster Boot	Tenacity/Body-Mind Unity	Magical cougar	East Caves (thermal springs)
Thunderbird	Chadwick Boot	Adventurous Soul	Storm-summoning avian	Cliffside Aeries
Pukwudgie	James Steward	Healer's Heart	Trickster guardian	Root Cellars (herb gardens)
Sorting Ritual: Students stand on the Gordian Knot. House totems react:


Horned Serpent glows for scholars.

Wampus roars for warriors.

Thunderbird beats wings for adventurers.

Pukwudgie raises arrow for healers.
(Students may choose if multiple react)

Curriculum: Woven Worlds Pedagogy
Blends European spellcraft with Indigenous spirit-work

CORE STUDIES (Years 1-6)

Wandlore & Wandmaking (The Maple Pact)

Ilvermorny Exclusivity: All wands use Native Maple wood + Wampus cat hair/Thunderbird feather cores.
Text: Webster Boot’s Grimoire: The Morality of Cores.

Magizoology of the First Nations

Units:
Skinwalker Ethics (treaty obligations).
Pukwudgie Diplomacy (gifting honey cure-alls).
Legendary Beasts: Training with Hodags (Wisconsin iron-skins).

Spirit Charms (Beyond Wandwork)

Borrow power from:
Manitou (forest spirits) for herbology.
Animikii (thunder beings) for tempest charms.
Taboo: Never compel a spirit—only request.

Rappaport’s Law & The Dangers of Exposure

Historical Trauma Module: Study Dorcus Twelvetrees' breach (1790).
Modern Protocol: Obliviator training simulations.

UNIQUE ELECTIVES

Apparition Cartography: Navigate ley lines beneath Muggle cities.

Dreamwalking (Anishinaabe Tradition): Astral projection via sweat lodge rituals.

Salem Trials Defense: Counter Magihysteria with illusion-breakers.

Cultural Touchstones

Festivals:
Stone Heart Ceremony (Nov. 16): Students add carvings to Isolt's original cottage.
Great Thunderbird Dive: Graduates leap from aeries; Thunderbirds catch them mid-fall.

Sport: Whirlwind Quodpot (exploding-quaffle variant played in tempests).

Food: Maple Syrup Potions (poured onto breakfast pancakes).

Governance & Politics

Leadership:
Headmaster (traditionally Thunderbird-aligned).
Council of Seven (4 house heads + 3 tribal elders).

MACUSA Relations:
Post-Rappaport’s Law (1790–1965), Ilvermorny operated under magical observation.
1965 Reconciliation: Joint No-Maj/Wizard outreach programs established.

Secrets & Artifacts

The Half-Finished Map: Chadwick's enchanted parchment showing "land where magic sleeps" (hints at pre-Columbian schools).

Slytherin's Original Wand: Embedded in Isolt's statue—secret Parseltongue trigger awakens basilisk defenses.

James’ Compass: Points toward No-Majs needing magical aid (only Pukwudgies inherit this trait).

Demographics & Legacy
Category	Data
Enrollment	~900 (60% North American)
Species	15% skin-walker descendants
Ghosts	Dorcus Twelvetrees – roams weeping, reenacting her betrayal

"We stitch old magic into new earth. Here, wands grow on trees, and thunder answers kindness."

— Headmaster Agilbert Fontaine, 1928


Notable Alumni

Seraphina Picquery (MACUSA President, Thunderbird).

Quincy McAllister (inventor of Self-Stirring Cauldrons, Horned Serpent).

Tallulah Deganawida (Wampanoag seer; predicted Grindelwald’s rise).

Modern Era

Wampus Warriors: Elite magical law enforcement track.

Thunderbird Crisis Response: Disaster-relief teams Apparating into hurricanes.

The MageTeK Scandal (1999): Students caught enchanting Boston’s subway to sing (exposed magic!).

Post-Statute Reforms:


Mandatory Magihistorical Reconciliation courses.

Durmstrang Exchange Program (2005): Cultural tension incidents sparked Wampus vs. Sentinel Golem duels.

entries.name: Koldovstoretz
entries.content:
Foundation & Veiled History

Established: 7th Century CE by Baba Yaga (pre-exile) and Volkhv Svyatoslav, to counter Nordic dark magic incursions.

True Name: Скрытая Роща (Skrytaya Roshcha – "Hidden Grove").

Location: Siberian Valley of Firebirds, warded by eternal permafrost domes; Muggles see derelict Tsarist mining colony.

Philosophy: "Жар подо льдом" ("Fire Beneath Ice") – Resilience through extremes.

Architecture: A Palace Forged from Frost and Folk Magic

Structure:
Tsar’s Spire: Gold-domed center tower housing Romanov-era artifacts.
Izba Classrooms: Mobile enchanted huts sprint on chicken legs (Baba Yaga’s legacy).
Veles Vaults: Subterranean libraries guarded by Slavic earth spirits (Zemnoy Dukh).

Defenses:
Firebird Aureole: Winged phoenix-kin scorch intruders.
Winter Wards: -50°C blizzards triggered by unauthorized apparition.
Whispering Birches: Sentinel trees report intruders in root-language.

Curriculum: Slavic Sorcery & Statecraft
Pedagogical Pillars

Zhar-Ptitsa Alchemy (Firebird Mysticism)

Koschei Politics (Immortality Ethics)

Leshy Ecology (Forest Sentience)

Core Studies (Years 1-6)
Subject	Focus	Unique Practice
Permafrost Potioneering	Brews harnessing Arctic cold	Severed finger regrowth via Iceweed Serum
Volkhv Ritualcraft	Communing with Slavic deities	Summon Perun’s Thunder for combat boosts
Zima Charms	Winter-adaptive spellwork	Biting Frost Shield — freezes incoming hexes
Matryoshka Animagi	Nested transformations (bear→hawk→fox)	Soul-shifting trials in Baba Yaga’s Huts
Golem Statecraft	Animate political puppets for strategy games	Simulate muggle revolution responses
Distinctive Traditions

Koldovstoretz Flights: Tree-Swiveling Quidditch
Brooms replaced by Uprooted Siberian Pines (enlarged/levitated).
Keepers defend floating ice-hoops; Bludgers → Snow Vultures.

Rite of the Deep Chill: First-years survive 72hrs in Glacier Catacombs (–60°C).

Firebird New Year: Graduates send wishes via phoenix fire; sparks bloom into Wish Orchids.

House System: The Unmelting Blades
(Assigned by tapping Tsar’s Scepter during Vechornytsi Ceremony)

House	Virtue	Emblem	Dormitory
Volkhvy	Mystical Mastery	Golden Firebird	Sky Palaces
Svarozhich	Fire Resilience	Braided Sun Wheel	Magma Chambers
Vodianoi	Adaptability	Ice-Drake	Subglacial Grottos
Leshonki	Wilderness Tactics	Living Oak Spirit	Canopy Villages
Governance: Bearers of the Ice Scepter

Headmaster: Zmey Gorynych (three-headed dragon animagus form mandatory).

Ukase Council: Tsar-appointed governors until 1917; now elected Volkhv elders.

Notable Leaders:
Anastasia Romanova (secretly survived via Koschei Pact; taught here 1922-1953).
Yekaterina Volkov (sank 1936 Muggle expedition using Arctic Mists).

Magical Demographics & Culture

Enrollment: 550 students (Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan).

Wand Cores: Firebird Feather (volatile), Permafrost Shard (durable).

Ghosts: Tsar Nicholas II’s Alchemist – brews phantom samovars.

Festivals:
Maslenitsa Magica: Butter-sculpture battles become real monsters.
Night of the Witch: Baba Yaga’s hologram critiques student potions.

Canonical References & Mysteries

Quidditch Mention: "Only school using living trees as brooms" (Pottermore Archive).

Romanov Relics:
Blood Tear Tiara: Stores sacrificial magic (death of Tsar’s family).
Rasputin’s Inferius Serum Notes.

Cold War Era: Koldovstoretz became ICW black site for testing Winter Hexes during Soviet rule.

Controversies

1986 Chornobyl Containment: Students secretly cast Radiation-Eating Mold Charms → magical mutations.

"Vampire Diplomat" Scandal: Headmistress hosted Transylvanian envoys; 3 students turned (1999).

Ethics Breach: Koschei Immortality Trials on prisoners (banned post-ICW investigation, 1931).

Post-Soviet Reforms

Legislative:
Severed state ties; ICW observers monitor Matryoshka Animagi trials.
Added No-Maj Relations course (required since 2000).

Magical Innovation:
Melting Curse Reversal – heroically thawed 2018 Siberian wildfires.
Firebird cloning to prevent extinction.


"We burn brightest when others freeze. Remember: magic – like Russia – is shaped by frost and fury."

— Headmaster Zmey Petrovich addressing NATO wizards, 2005


Known Alumni:


Ivan Karamazov (inventor of instant snow fortress spells).

Nadia Volkova (dueled Grindelwald to standstill in 1910; lost eye to Fiendfyre, replaced with enchanted ice lens).

Forbidden Archives:


Baba Yaga’s Unedited Grimoire (contains sentient hut binding rituals).

Koschei’s Deathless Formulae – locked in lead-lined vault beneath Lenin’s mausoleum.

entries.name: Mahoutokoro
entries.content:
Foundation & Cosmic Alignment

Established: c. 900 CE by Emperor Uda's court sorcerers during Heian Era height.

Location: Minami Iwo Jima volcano (disguised Muggle perception: "off-limits military base").

True Name: 光寿閣 (Kōju-kaku – "Palace of Eternal Illumination").

Purpose: Purify Yōma spirits and evolve magic beyond wand dependency.

Mahoutokoro Floating Sanctum
Architecture & Defenses

Structure: Tiered obsidian pagodas hovering over volcanic caldera; walkways of solidified lava.

Guardians:
Tsūten Vines: Carnivorous plants devouring dark magic residuals.
Komainu Golems: Twin lion-dog statues unleashing Miharayama firestorms.

Wards:
Ungyo-Sangyo Barrier: Projects image of active eruption to Muggles.
Moonlit Paths: Bridges appear only under shogun-star constellations.

The Enchanted Robes: Soul-Mapping Garments
Given at age 7; teleport wearer to school at 11


Magic Growth: Expands with child; weaves accomplishments into pigment:
Soft Rose → Novice
Gold → Mastery (→ Pearl White for betrayal).

Sentient Punishment: Turns white → reports crimes to Ministry → disintegrates (→ exile).

Battle Integration: Reinforced with Kikkō armor hex against curses.

Academic Doctrine: The Triple Wheels (三輪 Sanrin)

Heaven (天): Celestial magic & storm-calling

Earth (地): Spirit-taming & elemental alchemy

Human (人): Discipline-focused battle arts

CORE CURRICULUM
(Ages 7-17; boarding from 11)

I. HEAVENLY ARTS

Celestial Duelcraft (Ritō-Ryū)

Techniques:
Redirect lightning via Raijū Mirror Kata.
Summon Killer Frost Cyclones concentration.
Text: Genji Scrolls of Thunder (written on dragonfly-wing parchment).

Astral Navigation (Hoshi-Meguri)

Plot courses via Oba Sāman constellations.
Practical: Midnight broom races around caldera rim.

II. EARTHLY ARTS

Yōkai Relations (Mononoke-kaihō)

Diplomatic training with:
Negotiate truces with Kitsune tricksters.
Pacify Oni raiders via ritual sumo.
Fail Risk: Temporary transformation into Tanuki.

Volcanic Alchemy (Kazan Renkin)

Harvest cursed obsidian → forge Tsukumogami (living artifacts).
Famed Elixir: Shiranui Serum – walk through fire unscathed.

III. HUMAN ARTS

Onmyōdō Wizardry (Yin-Yang Mastery)

Cast spells with:
Ofuda talismans for elemental tethers.
Kuji-Kiri hand seals for wandless combat.
Forbidden Jutsu: Shikigami soul-binding (requires Ministry permit).

Steel-Blood Charmcraft (Hagane no Ikari)

Embed magic in katana → cut spells mid-flight.
Mastery Test: Deflect 100 caster Reducto barrage.

Distinctive Traditions

Gion Matsuri Duel Tournament: Floating lantern arenas over lava; losers drop into wards.

Tsukimi Ritual: Communicate with moon rabbits for prophecy.

Quidditch Variant: Shōgi Quodpot – exploding snitch; players ride Scarlet Magnolia brooms.

Governance & Honor Codes

Leadership: Osaō-sama (eternal phoenix animagus) + Ministry Observers.

Punishments:
Minor: Juzu Bead Curse – weighs limbs.
Major: Robe bleaching → Yūrei Exile (banishment with haunting).

Scandals:
1932: Student turned white → exposed wizards to Imperial Army.
1999: Kyoto Protocol Breach – animated Edo-period art attacked Muggles.

Magical Demographics
Category	Data
Enrollment	~300 (smallest great school)
Brooms	Scarlet Magnolia wood + Kitsune hair cores
Ghosts	Heian Court Poetess – recites failure warnings
Language	Spell incantations blend archaic Japanese
War Legacies

WWII Era: Shielded Hiroshima magical district from bomb via Yata Mirror wards.

Onin War (1467): Students commanded Tsuchigumo giant spiders.

Modern Threats: Contained Fukushima Noppera-bō spirits (2011).

Notable Alumni
Name	Legacy
Shinai Kurosawa	Invented Bottled Tsunami for coastal defense
Aiko Takahashi	First witch to tame Nine-Tails Kyuubi
Kenji Nakamura	Stopped volcanic eruption using Earthfold Sutras

"Your robe is your soul’s diary. Stain it with honor, not ash."

— Osaō-sama’s greeting to first-years


Post-2000 Reforms

Whispering Walls Policy: Classrooms shifted into pocket dimensions during earthquakes.

Yōkai Equality Act: Reserved seats for Kappa and Zashiki-warashi in ethics council.

Golden_Grace Initiative: White-robed exiles can redeem via spirit-cleansing pilgrimages.

Secrets:


Amaterasu's Forge: Molten core chamber → reforges damaged wands.

Moon Rabbit Hutch: Secret warren supplies lunar grief antidote.

entries.name: Uagadou
entries.content:
Foundation & Cosmic Significance

Established: c. 1000 BCE by *Sages of the Moon* (pre-dating Egyptian dynasties).

Location: Mountains of the Moon, Uganda (Ruwenzori Range); Muggles perceive clouds.

True Name: "Breath of Mkulu" (Great Spirit) in proto-Bantu.

Scale: Largest wizarding school globally (accepts students across the continent).

Uagadou Cloud-Walkers
Architecture & Defenses

Structure: Floating basalt terraces suspended over volcanic vents; buildings sculpted by earth magic.

Guardians:
Ngombe ya Maji (Water Cattle): Stone buffalo spouting boiling geysers.
Dream Serpents: Astral projections guarding sleep.

Wards:
Okuyamba Illusion: Rainforest canopy mimics aurora borealis to divert aircraft.
Silent Steps: All sound vanishes 500m from perimeter.

Admissions: The Voice of Dreams

Dream Messengers: Ivory hornbills deliver acceptance letters telepathically during sleep.

Test: Prospective students manifest "gifts" by age 10 (e.g., healing wounds with clay, vanishing footprints).

Academic Doctrine: Magic Without Wands
Emphasis on gestures, astral projection, and celestial will

Core Focus	Method	Mastery Tier
Wandless Casting	Hand-sign language (Isharo)	Year 2: Ignite fires via finger-snaps
Self-Transfiguration	Instant animal morphing	Year 5: Become mist/lightning
Astral Body Projection	Soul-walking (Kutoka Mwili)	Year 7: Teleport via dream realms
Celestial Alchemy	Brew starlight into potions	Year 6: Ngoma ya Atari – drum thunderstorms into vials
CURRICULUM
HEARTH DISCIPLINES (Years 1-4)

Sky Paths (Njia ya Angani)

Navigate constellations for teleportation anchors (Orion's Belt as stepping stones).
Text: Stellar Wind Charts carved on meteorites.

Talking Earth (Maji Na Udongo)

Control weather via ritual drums; redirect rivers with hand-claps.
Lab: Tectonic plate meditation chambers.

Shadow Skin (Kuvalisha Kivuli)

Human → animal metamorphosis:
Big Five Shift: Lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, buffalo (trial by savannah run).
Sentinel Test: Calm a stampede while morphed.

TOWER DISCIPLINES (Years 5-7)

Star Metal Forging (Chuma cha Nyota)

Shape enchanted iron from meteor cores → create vibration-sensitive tools.
Artifact: Kipanga cha Mwezi moon-sickle (harvests phantom crops).

Ancestral Dreamwalking (Ndoto za Babu)

Enter spirit worlds to consult elders; retrieve lost knowledge.
Dangers: Soul-trapping by Mzimu Weavers (spider-loa).

Mbube Potōmancy ("Lion Magic")

Roar-based battle magic:
Shatter mountains with Simba Sauti (Voice of Lion) hex.
Elite Skill: Turn enemies to ash with a whisper.

Cultural Pillars

Ruwa Maji Festival: Graduates summon rainbows to bridge mountains; dance on light paths.

Coming-of-Age Ritual: "Leopard's Silence" – spend 7 nights shapeshifted in jungle; hunt only darkness.

Sport: Mti wa Kupanda ("Tree Climb") – wandless dueling on acacia treetops over lion prides.

Governance & Ethics

Leadership: Wazee Wakuu (Council of Elders) led by Mkuu wa Mlima (Mountain Speaker).

Honor Code: "Magic Feeds the Land" – spells must nourish ecosystems.

Punishment: Dream Binding – offenders relive victims' nightmares.

Magical Demographics
Category	Data
Enrollment	~2,000+ students annually
Languages	Over 100 dialects; spell gestures are universal
Ghosts	Walkers of the Long Night – astral projections of starved ancestors
Fauna	Trained Afrit elementals staff kitchens
Historical Feats & Controversies

Great Colonial Resistance (1885): Turned British rifles into snakes.

Nigeria Civil War (1967): Shielded magical Lagos with Sango’s Thunder Dome.

Drought of '73: Students rerouted Nile tributaries → flooded Sudan.

Modern Era & Innovation

Astral Diplomacy: Hosts intercontinental meetings via shared dreams.

Pandemic Response: Juju Fog cured sleeping sickness in the Congo (2020).

Spell Tech: Gesture-recognition apps for muggle-born integration.

entries.name: Ministry of Magic
entries.content:
Foundation & Historical Spine

Established: 1707 after International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy ratification

Predecessor: Wizards' Council (medieval-era; disbanded for inefficiency)

Guiding Principle: "Magic Might Safely Flourish" (inscribed on Ministry seal)

Architectural Motto: "Tegmentum in Aeternum" ("Eternal Concealment")

Location & Access

Primary Entrance: Disused red telephone booth (dial 62442 = "MAGIC")

Secondary Entrances:
Floo Network Hub: "Ministry of Magic Atrium"
Apparition Points: Level 2 Check-In

Depth: 1.2km beneath Whitehall, London

Wards:
Tarnhelm Veil: Muggles perceive "leaky plumbing office"
Gemino Repello: Duplicates trap corridors for intruders

Departmental Structure (Ten Subterranean Levels)
LEVEL ONE: MINISTER'S SUITE

Office of Minister for Magic:
Black Walnut Doors: Morph carvings of current Minister's achievements
Reginald Pettigrew's Concealed Passage (post-Scrimgeour)

Ministers in Crisis:
Pius Thicknesse (Imperiused during Reign)
Kingsley Shacklebolt (tripled Auror fleet post-1998)

LEVEL TWO: MAGICAL LAW ENFORCEMENT (MLE)
Division	Function	Key Figures
Auror Office	Dark wizard capture	"Mad-Eye" Moody, Harry Potter
Hit Wizard Unit	High-risk arrests	Gawain Robards
Improper Use of Magic Office	Trace enforcement	Mafalda Hopkirk (OWL letters)
Wizengamot Admin	Trial logistics	Tiberius Ogden
LEVEL THREE: MAGICAL ACCIDENTS & CATASTROPHES

Accidental Magic Reversal Squad: Repair Statute breaches

LEVEL FOUR: REGULATION & CONTROL

Beast/Being/Spirit Divisions:
Werewolf Registry (controversial post-Greyback)

Goblin Liaison Office: Tense since 1612 Rebellion

Pest Advisory Bureau: Doxicide squads for infestations

LEVEL FIVE: MAGICAL COOPERATION

International Confederation of Wizards desk

Quidditch Affairs: World Cup oversight

Misuse of Muggle Artefacts: Arthur Weasley's domain (static radio collection)

LEVEL SIX: MAGICAL TRANSPORTATION

Floo Network Authority: Controls 1000+ UK fireplaces

Broom Regulatory Control: Racing licenses; Nimbus audits

LEVEL SEVEN: MAGICAL GAMES & SPORTS

Major event coordination (e.g., Triwizard Tournament)

Flying Inspection Office: Quidditch stadium standards

LEVEL EIGHT: ATRIUM & SUPPORT

Famous Features:
Golden Fountain → Magic is Might Monument (Voldemort era) → Fountain reinstallment
Security Desks: Writing-desks verifying wands

Wizarding Wireless Channel management

LEVEL NINE: TRIAL CHAMBERS

Courtroom Ten:
Harry's 1995 hearing; Lestrange's trials
Chains bind defendants to enchanted chair

Sentencing Pools: Temporary holding cells

LEVEL TEN: DEPARTMENT OF MYSTERIES
Chamber	Research Focus	Artifact/Securities
Hall of Prophecy	Future prediction	Harry (1995 shatter incident)
Death Chamber	Veil research (Deceased communication)	Sirius Black's fall site
Time Room	Temporal mechanics	Return-hourglass stockpile
Love Chamber	Emotional magic	Impenetrable plant barrier
Brain Room	Consciousness studies	Sentient-thought tanks
Space Chamber	Cosmic wormholes creation	Miniature galaxy models
✵ Room of Court	Hidden courtroom for Unspeakables	Wand-shackling thrones
Personae Dramatis
Notable Ministers (1707–Present)
Minister	Era	Policy/Scandal
Damocles Rowle	1718–1726	Brutal Muggle-born suppression
Nobby Leach	1962–1968	First Muggle-born Minister (resigned poisoned)
Millicent Bagnold	1980–1990	"The Wizards Celebrate" post-Voldemort (1981)
Cornelius Fudge	1990–1996	Denied Voldemort's return; sacked
Kingsley Shacklebolt	1998–present	Reformed Wizengamot; released innocent prisoners
Iconic Figures

Magical Maintenance Head: Bob (Dumbledore’s funeral crowd)

Enforcement Mechanics

Taboo Charm: Heavy prosecution during Deathly Hallows
Trace: Under-17 magic detection (modified post-Tonks fiasco)

1998 Corrupted Wizengamot: Blood purity trials under Voldemort

2006 House-Elf Chartered Representation Sit-in

Modern Reforms (2010s–Present)

F.A.I.R Framework (Freedom, Accountability, Integrity, Reconciliation):
Ousted pureblood holdouts
Wand licenses granted to Goblins/Centaur delegates

Hermione Granger—Muggle-Born Integration Head

Structural Magic & Mysteries

Undiscovered Chambers:
Merlin's Vault: Legendary relic repository,
Speakers' Pits: Chambers pith dark objects into screaming voices

Peak Staff: 1,524 (1991), 2,009 (current)

entries.name: The Wizards' Council
entries.content:
Foundation & Jurisdiction Time Period: Operated from medieval times until its dissolution in 1707 Purpose: Highest authority for magical affairs in Great Britain and Ireland Successor: Replaced by the Ministry of Magic following the 1692 International Statute of Secrecy Historical Depiction: Described as having occasional "inefficiency" by wizarding historians Key Governance Figures Chief Warlock Era Notable Policies & Controversies Burdock Muldoon 1400s • Organized the Faerie Summit: Restrictively defined "beings" by human appearance
• Excluded goblins, trolls, and centaurs → Summit failed Elfrida Clagg Late 1400s • Revised classification to language-based sentience: "beings" speak human language
• Unintentionally included jarveys (non-sentient), excluded merpeople (spoke Mermish) Critical Legislative Acts Quidditch Restrictions 1269: Banned Quidditch within 50 miles of towns 1362: Prohibited play near Muggle-populated areas after uproar in Barry, Wales 1368: Issued nationwide ban due to uncontrollable secrecy breaches Magical Creature Classification "Beings" (Sentient Rights): Broadened to include any creature speaking human language "Beasts": Creatures lacking speech capabilities despite intelligence (e.g., trolls, kelpies) Flaw: Sparked the revolt leading to modern self-classification system Notable Events & Failures The Faerie Summit Debacle (Muldoon Era): Humanoid-only attendance (hags, vampires, fairies) Non-humanoids (trolls/goblins) stormed summit with weapons → violent chaos Language Law Fallout (Clagg Era): Jarveys misclassified as sentient due to mimicking speech Merpeople ignored despite sophisticated underwater language Resolved by allowing creatures to self-identify Downfall & Legacy Secrecy Crisis: Inability to contain growing magical exposure pre-18th century Diabetes mellitus Final Dissolution: Officially dismantled during Ministry of Magic inception (1707) Lasting Influence: Inspired Ministry departments for Creature Regulation and Game Enforcement Warning against over-simplified definitions in magical legislation "The Council’s failures taught us: no parchment decree can contain the wild heart of magic." — Newt Scamander, Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

entries.content:

entries.name: Azkaban
entries.content:
Foundation & History

Origin: Built in 15th century by dark wizard Ekrizdis who lured/experimented on Muggle sailors

Location: Unplottable island in North Sea

Pre-Prison Era:
Ekrizdis's torture fortress with hidden dark magic
Abandoned after death; memory-charmed by authorities

1718: Became British wizarding prison under Minister Damocles Rowle

Governance: Operated by the Department of Magical Law Enforcement

Architecture & Atmosphere

Structure: Black stone fortress shaped like a jagged crown

Ambience:
Pervasive freezing cold
Constant dripping seawater
Screams echo through corridors day and night

Cell Design:
Minimal slitted windows
Stone slab beds
Enchanted damp walls suppress magic

Security & Guardians
Dementors

Deployed: Since 1718

Function:
Drain joy/hope via soul-sucking kiss
Patrol island, cells, perimeter

Prisoner Impact:
Insanity within weeks/months
Physical withering

Status: Removed post-1998 after Kingsley Shacklebolt's reforms

Secondary Defenses

Anti-Apparition Wards

Auror Patrol Boats (post-Dementor removal)

Sea Monster Guardians (Grindylows/Kappas in waters)

Life as an Inmate

Rations: Bland gruel slid through cell doors

Isolation: Prisoners confined >22 hours/day

Psychological Effects:
Memories of worst life events loop incessantly
Catatonia, loss of speech, self-harm

Noted Survivors:
Sirius Black (retained sanity by dog Animagus form)
Barty Crouch Jr. (unbroken via Dark Lord loyalty)

Notorious Figures & Events

Prisoner	Crime	Cell Block

Orchestrated by Voldemort
Bellatrix Lestrange + 9 Death Eaters escape

Death Eaters imprison Muggle-borns

Aurors now guard prisoners

Escaped as unregistered Animagus
Swam through North Sea

By the Numbers
Metric	Data
